title: Write. Pack. Render.
description: An 8.6-second slideshow built entirely with ffmpeg: three stills with slow Ken Burns zooms, smooth slide transitions and a music bed.

requires.why: builds and encodes the whole video
reads the finished video for the report

render.engine_command: ffmpeg -loop 1 -i <each slide> ... -filter_complex '<scale, zoompan, xfade chain>' <fastest encoder> write-pack-render.mp4   (graph built from src/slideshow.json)
